description:
## [1.13.0](https://github.com/rahul9999xda/morphe-patches/compare/v1.12.0...v1.13.0) (2026-10-17)
### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **telegram:** correct restriction patch register handling ([70f733b](https://github.com/rahul9999xda/morphe-patches/commit/70f733b30d0c943bba8c2be4f6328fa08158104f))

patches.name: Anti-delete messages
patches.description: Prevents messages deleted by other users from being removed locally.

patches.name: Anti-disappearing media
patches.description: Keeps view-once photos, videos and voice messages viewable indefinitely without modifying SecretMediaViewer lifecycle callbacks.

patches.name: Anti-screenshot notification
patches.description: Blocks screenshot notifications from being sent to the other user.

patches.name: Bypass channel restrictions
patches.description: Allows opening and viewing content from restricted, sensitive, and copyright-restricted channels.

patches.name: Bypass content restrictions
patches.description: Allows saving and forwarding content from restricted channels, chats, and users.

patches.name: Bypass integrity check
patches.description: Spoofs certificate fingerprint and SafetyNet results so login works on patched APK.

patches.name: Disable auto-update
patches.description: Disables Telegram update availability, update-version storage and proxy sponsor-channel insertion.

patches.name: Disable channel switching
patches.description: Disables the pull-down gesture that switches to the next unread channel when a stable target exists.

patches.name: Disable telemetry and analytics
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics collection where bundled and blocks app telemetry logging entry points.

patches.name: Download speed boost
patches.description: Increases download chunk size to 1 MB and max concurrent requests to 12.

patches.name: Hide Stories read status
patches.description: Prevents the client from processing and sending Stories read receipts.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Blocks Telegram's controller-level sendTyping dispatch on audited Telegram/Web 13.0.3 and Plus 13.0.2.0 builds.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored messages and video ads. On Telegram Plus also blocks current and legacy Plus ad-loader entry points.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Telegram Premium features for the current account.

patches.name: Voice to music
patches.description: Plays voice notes through the music-player path while preserving Raise-to-Listen.
